definitions.explanation: Soldiers who fight on horseback, or a military unit composed of such soldiers. Historically important in warfare, now largely ceremonial or used in historical and fantasy contexts.

examples.japanese: {騎兵|きへい}{隊|たい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{突撃|とつげき}→突撃：19005_totsugeki⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{中世|ちゅうせい}→中世：05524_chuusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{戦場|せんじょう}→戦場：12746_senjou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{騎兵|きへい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{戦力|せんりょく}→戦力：18977_senryoku⟧だった。
examples.english: Cavalry was an important fighting force on medieval battlefields.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銃|じゅう}→銃：10463_juu⟧や⟦{大砲|たいほう}→大砲：12172_taihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、{騎兵|きへい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}って→失う：01887_ushinau⟧いった。
examples.english: With the development of guns and cannons, cavalry gradually lost its role.

notes:
USAGE:
Appears in historical texts, military history, fantasy fiction, and games. The related compound {騎兵|きへい}{隊|たい} (cavalry unit) is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {騎兵|きへい}{隊|たい} (cavalry unit)
- {騎兵|きへい}⟦{突撃|とつげき}→突撃：19005_totsugeki⟧ (cavalry charge)
- {重|じゅう}{騎兵|きへい} (heavy cavalry)
- {軽|けい}{騎兵|きへい} (light cavalry)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{歩兵|ほへい}→歩兵：13223_hohei⟧: infantry — soldiers who fight on foot
- ⟦{砲兵|ほうへい}→砲兵：18085_houhei⟧: artillery — soldiers who operate cannons and guns
